o1: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in cell fate specification, including vulval cell fate specification; membrane fusion; and nematode larval development. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including ABprpppppaa; body wall muscle cell from MS lineage; nervous system; seam cell; and vulva.
